steps.does: Decompose the painting into layers: a full pass and a head pass
steps.bar: Both passes produce eyelid layers on both eyes; the lantern comes out as its own layer

steps.does: Turn layers into parts, in draw order, limbs cut at their joints; propose the split as an image, one label per part
steps.bar: Every part the assemble guide names exists (face untouched, lantern its own part); limbs cut at shoulder, elbow, wrist; every part has one label; the setup-pose recomposite matches the painting

steps.does: Place the bones; chains on the scarf, both coat tails and the hair tail; a hinge for the lantern under hand_r
steps.bar: Exactly the four chains the sentence names, plus the lantern hinge from the v1 feedback; no other chain

steps.does: Torso as a weighted mesh; head and lantern as rigid regions; the rest proposed
steps.bar: torso is a mesh; head and lantern are regions; 0 changed pixels inside the face box outside the eyelid masks, every frame

steps.does: Wind physics on scarf, coat tails and hair tail; a stop on the lantern hinge; nothing else on physics
steps.bar: Only scarf, coat tails, hair tail and the lantern hinge move on physics; the scarf's amplitude is the largest and the hair tail's the smallest; every other part changes 0 pixels from physics

agent_decision.reasoning: Physics extents are the item most often sent back; a motion sketch before the build is cheaper than a rebuild after.

steps.does: Breath on the torso, blink on the eyelids, flicker on the lantern; render the still-frame check
steps.produces: config motion; the still-frame check for rig-review
steps.bar: Every loop closes; breath, blink and flicker are each present as a track; the still-frame check renders at a fixed camera

steps.does: A slow push-in over the loop; no depth built
steps.bar: The push-in spans the full loop; no layer parallax; no depth sheet is built

steps.does: Eight-second loop; one beam sweep late in the loop
steps.produces: the take's length and beat sheet
steps.bar: The loop closes at 8.0 s; exactly one beam sweep, starting between 5.5 s and 7.0 s; for the scarf, coat_tail_l, coat_tail_r, hair_tail and lantern_hinge chain tips, each boundary jump at 8 s and 16 s in a three-period measurement twin is no larger than that tip's own largest in-loop step in the adjacent periods. Run node_modules/.bin/rigc render --candidate derived/loop-twin --animation idle --fps 24 --geometry --out derived/loop-reading. Read each named chain's tip bone in the built rig's geometry.json, compute its world-space endpoint per frame, take Euclidean distances between consecutive endpoints, and compare steps 191-to-192 and 383-to-384 with that tip's largest consecutive step inside each adjacent 192-frame period, excluding the boundary steps

steps.does: Frame with the whole lighthouse in shot; keep the painting's exposure
steps.bar: The lighthouse is fully in frame on every frame; mean luminance within 2% of the painting's
